title: Approved tenant/store mapping artifact (T-02)
description: Strict contract for an approved tenant/store mapping artifact. The top-level object must carry rows plus approval metadata (meta). This schema is structural: ordering, disposition-specific tenantId requirements, D7 distinct-approver enforcement, and cross-field ownership binding are enforced by scripts/tenant-mapping-artifact.js, which reuses the legacy preflight validator. The legacy preflight input contract (bare array or { rows }) is unchanged and documented separately; it does not satisfy this approved contract. No approver identity field exists: reviewer IS the approver.

rows.description: Mapping rows in input order. Row order is preserved and rowIndex values are stable. storeId values must be unique across rows (DUPLICATE_STORE_ID). tenantId is required when disposition is MAP (MAP_TENANT_REQUIRED). Unknown row fields are rejected.

storeId.description: Positive integer store id. Numeric strings of positive integers are accepted by the validator.

disposition.description: Explicit disposition. Only these four values are accepted.

tenantId.description: Target tenant id. Required when disposition is MAP; must be a positive integer when present.

source.description: Free-text origin label for the row (for example the review ticket or spreadsheet tab). This is a label, not an identity: preparer must never be inferred from source. Compared against reviewer under D7 after trimming.

reviewer.description: Identity that reviewed and approved this row. reviewer IS the approver; there is no separate approver field. Must differ from normalized source under D7 (SELF_APPROVAL). Case-insensitive comparison after trimming.

approval.description: Row approval. The strict artifact contract requires exactly 'approved'. Approval is the act of the reviewer identity.

effectiveAt.description: Row effective timestamp as accepted by the legacy preflight contract (trimmed text; the legacy validator does not date-parse it). Ownership timestamps preparedAt/reviewedAt in meta are strictly ISO-8601 UTC validated.

meta.description: Artifact-level ownership and approval metadata. All fields are required. preparer and reviewer are independent identities (they may be the same or different); the contract allows preparer != reviewer. reviewer here must equal every row reviewer (single-approver artifact binding).

preparer.description: Identity of the person who prepared the mapping artifact. Required, non-empty after trimming. Never inferred from source.

reviewer.description: Identity that approved the artifact. reviewer IS the approver. Must equal every row reviewer after trimming (case-insensitive); mismatch is META_REVIEWER_MISMATCH.

approval.description: Artifact approval. Must be exactly 'approved' (the approval act of the reviewer identity).

preparedAt.description: Artifact preparation timestamp. ISO-8601 UTC (for example 2026-09-25T00:00:00.000Z). Strictly validated as a real calendar instant.

reviewedAt.description: Artifact review/approval timestamp. ISO-8601 UTC, strictly validated as a real calendar instant.

evidenceRef.description: Opaque reference to the retained approval evidence bundle (for example a review ticket id or evidence bundle name). The validator requires a non-empty reference only; it does not resolve locations and no filesystem or deployment paths are defined by this contract.
